versions.content: Ability to return transport errors count information from RTE API calls The configuration of attribute NonqueuedReceiverComSpec.trans- portErrorCountEnabled allows for the extension of RTE APIs related to the ref- erenced dataElement in the context of the enclosing PortPrototype such that information about the number of transport errors can be retrieved.
